review:
John Hunter and the Aztec Treasure is an earlier entry in the series that uses a variable pay-ways layout instead of fixed lines. The number of ways can change from spin to spin, which gives the base game a less predictable rhythm than a standard 5x3 slot.

An ancient book plays a part in the free spins round, where every win is multiplied by up to 10x. That multiplier is the key to the bonus's value. Pragmatic Play doesn't list a maximum win for this title on its site. The RTP is 96.5%. It's worth a look if you want to see how the John Hunter series began before it moved towards money-collect mechanics.
